esqlQuery.esql: FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "api-gateway" AND name == "POST /api/orders" AND attributes.http.status_code == 200 AND @timestamp > NOW() - 5 minutes | EVAL ms = duration / 1000000 | STATS n = COUNT(*), p95 = ROUND(PERCENTILE(ms, 95), 0) | WHERE n >= 5 AND p95 > 500
